notes.title: Beta Demo 1.24.0 update change notes
notes.content:
Implements new graphics and stageset, enemy improvements, and various quality of life enhancements.
[list]
[*] New Default Stageset
[*] Revisions to Flamethrower Tank enemy
[*] New animated trees stage graphics
[*] Controls fixes and improvements
[*] Difficulty selection moved to 'Play' submenu
[*] Additional options added in Settings Menu
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Demo 1.23.9 update change notes
notes.content:
Includes moderate quality of life and graphical improvements.
[list]
[*] Control fixes & improvements allow players to hold Shift/L1 for slowed movement on analog controls in addition to pads and keyboard
[*] Improvements to main menu, including more elaborate instruction section
[*] Added page burn shader FX when dialogue bulletins disappear
[*] Added small blowback to deployed aerotorpedos if they take damage but are not killed
[*] Under-the-hood improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Demo 1.23.7 update change notes
notes.content:
Small update including quality of life improvements.
[list]
[*]Stage Intro & Dialogue improvements
[*]Small difficulty adjustments
[*]Menu Improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Demo 1.23.6 update change notes
notes.content:
Very small update with features of note:
[list][*] Stage 2 Boss main turret now shoots bullets from the left, right, and center tripple gun barrels. Stage 2 Bossfight combat is now more engaging.
[*] Added new intro and visual effects to GameOver menu w/ rewrite.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Demo 1.23.5 update change notes
notes.content:
Visual polish and under-the-hood changes.
[list]
[*]New 'Stage End Result' bulletin graphics
[*]Added Background Wallpaper ("Sideart")
- Can be toggled in the settings menu
[*]Small visual improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Demo 1.23.1 update change notes
notes.content:
Very small update with mostly under-the-hood code changes.
[list]
[*]Newly reworked End Stage Result "Bonus Points" dialogue now includes an animated intro and new graphics.
[*]Tweaks and HP adjustments to various enemies. e.g. Landcarrier subturrets now shoot more.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Demo 1.23 update change notes
notes.content:
Mostly under-the-hood code changes. A few things that may be noticeable to note;
[list]
[*] Stage introduction title graphics now use improved number graphics that more closely match the theme of the text. Also, some stages now have corrected numbers for their titles.
[*] (some) double turrets now have recoil animation
[*] Slight increase to horizontal pan, which effectively is an increase to player horizontal movement speed.
[*] Adjustments to level loading so loads may appear slightly smoother
[*] Lighting system rework (may have broken lighting on some stages)
[*] Improved tile textures
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Demo 1.22 update change notes
notes.content:
Some small changes made to the Beta Demo in response to feedback received during Nextfest Feb 2024.
[list][*] set the default demo difficulty from 'Beginner' to 'Casual' for an easier time for inexperienced players
[*] in 'Casual' difficulty, enemy bullets now move notably slower	
[*] in 'Casual' difficulty, players now have +1 hitpoint before death
[*] Main menu now includes a brief text tutorial explaining basic controls
[*] Made enemy bullets on any difficulty very slightly slower[/list]
